title: Member Profile Badges
text:
## Member Profile Badges
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055542
Add credibility and more awareness to member profiles by assigning unique digital badges to specific membership levels.
Upload the own badge images and assign them to the membership levels. Once uploaded, all the member profiles in that membership level will display their special digital badge.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Member Profile Badges Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On
1. Go to Finance > Membership Plans :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091846857/original/So3OJjJTiB83Fr4DN2jdKDkQs0kej-jyEQ.png?1619481471 | alt: ]
2. Find the membership plan and click on Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091846859/original/t6WT8YzQ8Y4Uk5ndl_V4jhM7GC1Y0jVtYg.png?1619481492 | alt: ]
3. Click on the Profile Page tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091846903/original/Q7fxUL_ErKRqvMllB3gvXIrSm0Sua5GCmQ.png?1619481647 | alt: ]
4. Scroll down until the admin sees these options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091846919/original/yuxHy7JYAeF5FqaumHt-Qbc_9l9UqlWM-g.png?1619481691 | alt: ]

## Recommended sizes
Profile Page Badge: 50px x 50px
Search Results Badge: 50px x 50px
Member Dashboard Badge: 250px x 250px
Once uploaded, all members in that membership plan will have the profile badge.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091847216/original/7J_tq-EGoVqBoIwIkzVI4OmaRp04c12qWQ.png?1619482415 | alt: ]
